params.prompt: Full-body front-view color character illustration based on the attached recent reference photos (2025-2026) of the real Korean MMA fighter Kim Seung-yeon, stylized as a grounded anime character while keeping his real face, beard, hair, build and tattoos recognizable. Keep his real facial proportions from the photos: the spacing between the eyes, the eye size, the nose length and the distance from the eyes to the mouth exactly as in the photos; do not set the eyes wider apart. He stands relaxed but perfectly balanced with his weight even on both feet, arms hanging loosely at his sides, hands half open, chin level, a calm, laid-back, slightly amused face with a closed mouth. He is a 37-year-old Korean man, a retired ROAD FC lightweight striker with a long karate background who now runs a small boxing and MMA gym and surfs often: 180 cm, about 7.5 heads tall with realistic proportions, a tall, lean, long-limbed build with long arms and legs, a narrow waist, flat lean muscle on the shoulders and arms, not bulky. Light warm skin with a light tan. A long narrow face with high defined cheekbones, narrow single-lidded eyes with a calm look, thick straight black eyebrows, a straight nose; a full thick black beard about two centimeters long that covers the jaw and chin and joins a full moustache, neatly kept. His current hair: thick, wavy black hair of medium length, loosely pushed back and a little messy, a few wavy strands falling on the forehead, the ends reaching over the tops of the ears; no cap. Tattoos: dense dark blue-grey tattoo sleeves on both arms from the shoulders down to the wrists, drawn as abstract ink shapes with no readable letters, symbols or faces, the same density on both arms. Outfit: a plain muted wine-burgundy short-sleeved gym t-shirt (#5C3B40), plain charcoal loose training pants (#333336) without stripes, bare feet. Plain unbranded clothing. Colors: light warm skin with mauve shadows, black hair and beard, blue-grey tattoo ink, the muted wine t-shirt as the main tone and the charcoal pants; no orange anywhere. Plain warm off-white paper background (#F4EFE6) with a soft grounding shadow under the feet, whole body visible from hair to soles. Muted cinematic anime cel shading, like a still from a grounded theatrical anime film: flat colors with one crisp shadow tone (a second darker tone only under the chin and beneath the brow), skin shadows in soft mauve-brown, shadows on white cloth in cool blue-grey, soft pink flush on cheeks, nose tip, ears and knuckles. Bold, slightly rough warm near-black outlines (#1A1417), thick on the silhouette and thin inside. Low-to-medium saturation, no gradients on the character, no glossy highlights, no rim-light glow, no eye sparkle, very subtle paper grain. Avoid: big shiny anime eyes, eye highlights, wide-set eyes, spiky anime hair, glossy skin, elongated 9-head fashion proportions, bodybuilder muscles, readable letters inside the tattoos, a chest tattoo, scars, bandages, gloves on the hands, a cap, glasses, sunglasses, a championship belt, cigarettes, smoking, alcohol, brand logos, any readable text, letters, numbers, labels, watermarks or signatures.
